name: windy-chat-agent-roster
description: Multi-tenant Matrix listener for every hatched Windy Fly agent. Logs in as each agent stored in agent_credentials and responds in their DM rooms.

scripts.// test: Explicit glob, NOT `node --test tests/` — directory mode descends into node_modules and dies before running anything. Every other service uses `npm test`, and this one had no test script at all, which is why CI silently covered zero of these 90 tests.
